title: 🔥 WHY DO PRIESTS CALL THEMSELVES ‘FATHER’? – THE TRUTH REVEALED! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 WHY DO PRIESTS CALL THEMSELVES ‘FATHER’? – THE TRUTH REVEALED! 🔥
📖 Matthew 23:9 – "And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and He is in heaven."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I always hear Catholic priests being called ‘Father,’ but Jesus clearly said, ‘Call no man father.’ Is this practice biblical, or is it a man-made tradition?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people blindly accept religious traditions without ever asking, "Is this in the Bible?"
🚨 Today, we will expose the truth—what Jesus REALLY meant and whether priests should be called "Father."
Let’s dive into BIBLICAL TRUTH!

🔥 1. WHAT DID JESUS MEAN BY ‘CALL NO MAN FATHER’?
📖 Matthew 23:8-10 – "But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers. And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and He is in heaven. Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Messiah."
🔥 Jesus was NOT talking about biological fathers (because the Bible commands us to honor them). Instead, He was warning about spiritual pride and religious leaders who exalt themselves above others.
🚨 In Matthew 23, Jesus was rebuking the Pharisees—the corrupt religious leaders who loved titles, power, and control over people.

✔️ They loved to be honored and worshiped.
✔️ They made themselves spiritual authorities above others.
✔️ They added traditions that were not from God.
💡 Does this sound familiar? Many religious leaders today demand honor, titles, and obedience—just like the Pharisees!
🚨 Jesus warned us: DO NOT follow their example!

🔥 2. IS IT BIBLICAL TO CALL A PRIEST ‘FATHER’?
🔥 NO! This practice is NOT found in the Bible—it is a man-made religious tradition.
📖 Mark 7:8 – "You have let go of the commands of God and are holding on to human traditions."

The Roman Catholic Church justifies calling priests "Father," saying it is a term of respect. But the real danger is that many people see priests as having divine authority, placing them between God and man.
🚨 This is unbiblical! There is only ONE mediator between God and man—JESUS CHRIST!
📖 1 Timothy 2:5 – "For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus."
🔥 No priest, pope, or pastor has the power to stand between you and God!
💡 Are you following Jesus, or religious traditions?

🔥 3. PRIESTS CLAIM TO FORGIVE SINS—BUT ONLY GOD CAN!
📖 Luke 5:21 – "Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
🔥 Catholic priests not only call themselves "Father," but they also claim to have the power to forgive sins.
🚨 This is a dangerous deception! The Bible is clear: ONLY GOD CAN FORGIVE SINS!
📖 1 John 1:9 – "If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness."

❌ Confessing sins to a priest is NOT biblical.
✔️ The Bible commands us to confess directly to God!
🚨 If you are trusting in a priest for forgiveness, you are putting your faith in man, NOT in Jesus!
💡 Who do you trust for your salvation—Jesus, or a religious system?

🔥 4. RELIGIOUS LEADERS EXALTING THEMSELVES = A DANGEROUS SIGN!
📖 Matthew 23:12 – "For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted."
🔥 Jesus never gave His disciples titles like "Father," "Pope," or "Priest." Instead, He told them to be humble servants.

✔️ Jesus washed His disciples’ feet (John 13:14-15).
✔️ The apostles never took special titles—they called themselves "servants of Christ" (Romans 1:1).
✔️ Peter, whom Catholics claim was the "first pope," rejected worship (Acts 10:25-26).
🚨 But today, many priests, popes, and religious leaders demand honor, power, and recognition.
💡 Are you following humble servants of Christ, or prideful men who seek their own glory?

🔥 5. REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – ESCAPING RELIGIOUS DECEPTION!
A Catholic man once believed that only priests could forgive sins and that the pope was the "Holy Father."
🔥 One day, he read Matthew 23:9 and realized that Jesus forbids calling religious leaders ‘Father.’
🚨 He searched the Bible and found that salvation is through Jesus ALONE—not through priests, popes, or the Catholic Church.
🔥 He left man-made religion and gave his life fully to Christ!
💡 Are you following Jesus, or just following religious traditions?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: RELIGIOUS TITLES WILL NOT SAVE YOU!
📖 Galatians 1:8 – "But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel other than the one we preached to you, let them be under God’s curse!"
🚨 Millions are being deceived into following religious systems instead of following Jesus!

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Blindly follow religious traditions that go against the Bible?
✔️ Follow Jesus Christ, who is the ONLY way to salvation?
🚨 CHOOSE NOW—BECAUSE YOUR ETERNITY DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 PRAYER TO FOLLOW JESUS, NOT RELIGION
"Lord Jesus, open my eyes to see the truth. I want to follow YOU, not man-made traditions. I surrender my life to You alone. Teach me Your ways, and help me walk in truth. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
